# Knowledge root (generated — do not edit)

Resolved from this workspace's Knowledge binding at sync time and
regenerated on every `software-team-agents sync`.

KNOWLEDGE_ROOT=C:\src\knowledge-vunsen

Module documents live under `<root>/_docs/module/<name>/` inside that
repository. This dev workspace treats that tree as READ-ONLY context;
documents are written by analysis roles in the Knowledge workspace
(`software-team-agents ba`), never here.
